title: Senior Artificial Intelligence Specialist
job_description: Job Title: Senior Artificial Intelligence (AI) Specialist Location: Singapore Employment Type: Full-time Role Overview Geolah is seeking a highly skilled Senior Artificial Intelligence (AI) Specialist to lead the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of advanced AI solutions. This role focuses on Generative AI (GenAI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic AI systems, with a strong emphasis on production readiness and measurable business impact. You will operate in a hybrid capacity, bridging technical teams and business stakeholders to translate real-world challenges into scalable, high-impact AI solutions. Key Responsibilities AI Design & Development Strategize, design, build, train, and deploy machine learning and AI models, including LLMs, computer vision, and predictive analytics solutions Develop scalable, efficient, and maintainable AI architectures for production environments Agentic AI Systems Design and implement autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and executing multi-step tasks Integrate agent-based workflows into core business operations AI Engineering & MLOps Build, deploy, and maintain MLOps and LLMOps pipelines for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring Automate workflows to enhance model performance, scalability, and reliability Production Deployment Deploy AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) Utilize containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes to enable scalable deployments Stakeholder Management & Strategy Act as a trusted technical advisor to business stakeholders Translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions and identify high-impact use cases Drive AI adoption and innovation across the organization Responsible AI & Governance Ensure AI systems are ethical, transparent, and compliant with data privacy regulations (e.g., PDPA) Establish best practices for model governance, fairness, and robustness Leadership & Mentorship Mentor and guide junior engineers and data scientists Promote best practices in AI engineering, coding standards, and system design Core Requirements Minimum 5+ years of experience delivering AI solutions from concept to POC Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (PhD preferred for specialized roles) Strong programming expertise in Python Proven experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Solid understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning) Familiarity with microservices architecture and RESTful API development Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) Domain expertise in financial services, manufacturing, logistics, or supply chain systems Industry Experience (Required/Preferred) Ride-hailing and mobility platforms Parcel delivery and logistics Financial services and digital payments platforms such Paylah, Paynow & AliPay
